limits: Visual style consistency is reviewer judgment, not a pixel-identical claim.
64px-long-edge maple and pine twigs differ subtly; world foliage and particle silhouettes remain recognizable.
Composite placements demonstrate six existing species and three branches, not runtime layouts or current level capacity.
Background drizzle retains a few fine rain streaks only at far side margins; central board remains clear.
Unity importer pivots, device screenshots, particle playback and timed runtime samples are NOT_RUN.
